content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-first-principles-definitive-3|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-products-everything-you-need|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital-8|NOWPayments Integration]] for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy offer similar services: payment processing, product hosting, and customer management. However, they are fundamentally bound by the regions they operate in, restricting access to creators in countries like Nigeria. While they might provide robust features for those who qualify, the lack of regional support translates to lost opportunities for countless digital creators. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, empowers creators with tools such as Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, enabling full control and ownership without the constraints of traditional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, leaving many creators in Nigeria and similar regions without viable options. PayPal, while more widespread, can suspend accounts and freeze funds for up to 180 days without recourse, creating a volatile environment for digital sellers. Conversely, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to sidestep these limitations entirely. By offering solutions that work universally, COREMERCH ensures that creators are not hindered by arbitrary geographic restrictions, allowing them to focus on building their businesses instead of navigating platform limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors in choosing a platform. Stripe and PayPal often impose waiting periods before funds are accessible, along with substantial transaction fees that can cut into profits. For example, PayPal’s fees can be as high as 3.5% plus a fixed fee per transaction, depending on the country. In contrast, NOWPayments, integrated with the Edge Commerce Stack, charges only a 0.5% fee with the added benefit of instant payment confirmation on-chain. This means creators can enjoy quicker access to their revenue and lower overall costs, enhancing their profitability.
Sovereign infrastructure gives you complete control over your digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a significant concern when using conventional platforms. With services like Stripe and PayPal, creators often do not own their customer data fully, which can be detrimental if they encounter issues with the platform. Additionally, automated delivery of digital products can be cumbersome. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure grants complete ownership of data, ensuring that creators retain control over their relationships with customers. With automated tools that seamlessly deliver products upon payment confirmation, creators can provide a smooth customer experience without relying on a third party.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Your choice of architecture should depend on your specific circumstances and goals as a creator. If you are located in a restricted region, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. It allows you to deploy a fully operational online store quickly and efficiently, offering the tools needed for product delivery and payment processing without the constraints of conventional platforms. For those ready to take control of their digital commerce, investing in sovereign infrastructure is the most viable long-term solution.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
No waiting periods or frozen funds with NOWPayments.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
